No repo or toolchain is available here. Give a concrete plan: what is right and wrong in these three proposals, what the package actually needs before publishing, and which commands would validate it.

evals.prompt: Our federated plugin battery_pro has an app-facing package, battery_pro_platform_interface, and endorsed battery_pro_android/ios. We need to add a new method `getHealthReport()` to the platform interface and expose it. Is this a breaking change for third-party implementations? What version bumps are needed where, and how do we keep existing Android/iOS consumers working? Also, a security advisory just hit one of our dependencies.
evals.expected_output: Correctly states adding a method to a platform interface is NOT breaking when implementations extend (not implement) the interface via plugin_platform_interface or base, and that a default implementation or UnimplementedError keeps endorsed impls working.; Applies correct bumps: interface package patch or minor per its own policy, app-facing minor for the new feature, implementation packages minor; explains Dart 0.x shifted-slot semver if any package is pre-1.0.; Treats the advisory as urgent: upgrade dependency to non-affected version, notes ignored_advisories only affects root packages so suppressing does not protect consumers.

evals.prompt: I'm building a Flutter widget package that draws animated progress rings around arbitrary child content, and it calls a MethodChannel 60 times per second during animation for native telemetry. Consumers report jank on low-end devices. Review these design choices and propose fixes with verification steps. Also: should I override operator == on my widget to skip rebuilds, and can I move the channel work to an isolate?
evals.expected_output: Identifies the 60Hz channel chatter as the primary suspect (serialization + thread hop per call) and proposes batching or removing per-frame channel traffic; recommends the child pass-down pattern for animated wrappers around consumer content.; Rejects operator == on widgets citing the documented O(N^2) behavior and suggests same-instance child reuse instead.; Explains isolates do not remove channel serialization costs and Flutter web does not support isolates; proposes profile-mode DevTools measurement in an example app before and after each change.
expectations: Identifies the 60Hz channel chatter as the primary suspect (serialization + thread hop per call) and proposes batching or removing per-frame channel traffic; recommends the child pass-down pattern for animated wrappers around consumer content.
Rejects operator == on widgets citing the documented O(N^2) behavior and suggests same-instance child reuse instead.
Explains isolates do not remove channel serialization costs and Flutter web does not support isolates; proposes profile-mode DevTools measurement in an example app before and after each change.
